description: Deterministic checklist for post-implementation review. Each agent evaluates the same items every time. Severity: blocking (must fix), concern (log, optional fix), nit (log, non-blocking).

Auto-Eval.description: Deterministic gate runner. All checks are scripted, not LLM-judged.

items.description: npm run harness:gate passes (all 5 pillars)
items.verification: shell: npm run harness:gate

items.description: npm run guardrails passes (no secrets, no legacy identifiers, no cross-app imports)
items.verification: shell: npm run guardrails

items.description: No new console.log / console.error in diff (use logger instead)
items.verification: shell: git diff | grep -E '^\+.*console\.(log|error)' || true

items.description: Type check passes for affected workspaces
items.verification: shell: npm run typecheck (scoped)

QA Agent.description: Test and verification checklist. Mix of deterministic and agent-judged items.

items.description: At least one test was added or updated for new behavior
items.verification: agent: inspect diff for test files (*.test.*, *.spec.*, __tests__)

items.description: Claimed tests actually pass (agent ran them or CI passed)
items.verification: shell: npm run test (scoped to affected workspace)

items.description: Error paths have test coverage or explicit justification
items.verification: agent: inspect new routes/handlers for try/catch and check if tested

items.description: No obvious journey gaps (e.g., new route not linked from UI)
items.verification: agent: trace user journey from entry point to new feature

Verifier.description: Skeptical spot-check. Confirm claims match reality.

items.description: All claimed changed files exist at claimed paths
items.verification: shell: ls <claimed files>

items.description: Git diff shows the claimed changes (no phantom claims)
items.verification: shell: git diff --stat

items.description: Claimed behavior can be evidenced (test output, curl, or code trace)
items.verification: agent: run narrowest command that exercises the claim

items.description: No dead code or unused imports introduced
items.verification: agent: grep for unused variables/imports in changed files

Product Manager.description: Product fit check. Only runs when acceptance criteria exist.

items.description: Each acceptance criterion is either met or explicitly deferred
items.verification: agent: compare Sprint Contract criteria against implementation

items.description: No scope creep beyond Sprint Contract or task description
items.verification: agent: compare diff scope against agreed scope

items.description: User-facing copy/labels are correct and consistent with product terminology
items.verification: agent: inspect changed UI strings against PRODUCT_REQUIREMENTS.md

Visual Designer.description: UI visual audit for UI-affecting changes only. Runs the Rendered-Truth Visual Gate (render + npm run audit:visual + vision review). Filled by a VISION-CAPABLE reviewer (OpenCode: multimodal-looker), NOT the Lovart/Stitch brief-generator agent. Rendered correctness defects (VD-05/06/07) are BLOCKING; craft (spacing, AI slop, tokens) stays concern to prevent nit-chasing.

items.description: Spacing follows 8rpx rhythm (mini-program) or 8px grid (admin-client) — craft
items.verification: agent: measure rendered gaps against ui-layout-audit spacing table

items.description: Uses design-system tokens (colors, typography) instead of hardcoded values
items.verification: agent: grep changed files for hex codes / px font sizes outside token system

items.description: Accessibility: reduced-motion respected, touch targets ≥44px/88rpx
items.verification: agent: inspect animation code and touch target sizes

items.description: No AI-generated visual slop (inconsistent borders, misaligned elements, generic layouts) — craft
items.verification: agent: vision-review the screenshot per frontend-design-audit Anti-Slop Checklist

items.description: RENDERED CORRECTNESS: no text overflow / truncation (without ellipsis) / unreachable clipping
items.verification: agent: npm run audit:visual → text-clip-horizontal/text-clip-vertical blocking violations; confirm on screenshot

items.description: RENDERED CORRECTNESS: no element overlap, no page horizontal overflow, nothing bleeding past the viewport edge
items.verification: agent: npm run audit:visual → text-on-text-overlap/page-horizontal-overflow/element-off-right-edge; confirm on screenshot

items.description: RENDERED CORRECTNESS: body text contrast ≥4.5:1, large text ≥3:1
items.verification: agent: npm run audit:visual → low-contrast-text blocking band; confirm on screenshot

User Satisfaction Auditor.description: User-perspective satisfaction audit for user-facing frontend changes only (apps/mini-program/src/pages/**). Runs ONLY when the diff touches a user-facing surface; skipped for backend/admin-client-only changes. Loads user-satisfaction-audit: picks a named persona, walks the RENDERED surface in first person, scores the six angles. All items are concern-level to prevent nit-chasing EXCEPT US-04: an emotional peak delivered without ceremony is blocking because it burns the product's strongest retention asset.

items.description: Persona walk performed on the RENDERED surface (named persona, first-person narration with friction/delight beats) — not code-only review
items.verification: agent: run npm run audit:visual or capture a screenshot, then narrate the journey per user-satisfaction-audit references/journey-narration-template.md

items.description: Angle 1 — 3-second clarity: purpose and next action obvious within 3 seconds; one dominant CTA
items.verification: agent: first-glance test on the render; identify the element the eye lands on and the CTA's relative weight

items.description: Angle 2 — cognitive smoothness: new/changed copy parses on first read; no server vocabulary (matched, venue_unlocked, status enums) or compound status+instruction sentences
items.verification: agent: read every new user-facing string aloud as the persona; flag re-reads and decoding moments

items.description: Angle 4 — emotional peaks (match reveal, squad unboxing, onboarding completion, first payment, gathering-room first entry, flash story ending gallery) must have a ceremony arc (build-up → reveal → celebration); a peak delivered as a data table, instant redirect, or unframed toast is a retention-killing defect
items.verification: agent: if the diff touches an emotional peak surface, walk that moment as the persona and confirm the arc exists; skip (N/A) when no peak surface changed

items.description: Angle 5 — return hooks: the flow's terminal screen leaves something pending (identity, progress, people, scheduled reveal) or explicitly justifies closure
items.verification: agent: inspect the last screen of the changed flow; name the concrete reason the persona returns within 7 days

items.description: Angle 6 — share-worthiness: changed share surfaces (posters, result cards, reveals) survive thumbnail scale, flatter the user, and carry natural attribution
items.verification: agent: squint/thumbnail test on the render; write the caption the persona would send; skip (N/A) when no share surface changed

delta_review_rules.description: Delta review is NOT implemented as of 2026-08-13 — no persistence layer exists, every review runs full/stateless. Re-enable only after the reviews directory wiring is built.
